hints.title: Consecutive Bar Removal
hints.text: Removing c consecutive bars creates a continuous gap of length c + 1.

hints.title: Maximum Consecutive Segments
hints.text: Sort hBars and vBars. Find the length of the longest consecutive subsegment of removed bars in both dimensions.

hints.title: Square Dimension Bound
hints.text: A square hole can have side at most min(max_consecutive_h + 1, max_consecutive_v + 1). Return side * side.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.time: O(H log H + V log V)
complexity.notes: Sorting removed bar arrays and finding longest consecutive runs.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Examining non-consecutive bar subsets does not enlarge gap sizes.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognize that only consecutive removed bars create larger single contiguous gaps.
